title: Battle of Alvar
text: The Battle of Alvar was a significant engagement during the Ottoman-Safavid War of 1578–1590. On September 21, 1585, the Ottoman army, under the command of Özdemiroğlu Osman Pasha, defeated the Safavid forces led by Hamza Mirza. Following this victory, the Ottoman military advanced to capture Tabriz on September 25, 1585.
